messages.displayText:
Thanks for choosing Lumi Cab! Just <U+E300>710 for any
destination in town. Where are you headed?

Sorry, but no ride if you don’t have the cash!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
New policy. We used to ask for the fare after the
ride, but sometimes a battle would break out...

Thanks for choosing Lumi Cab! Just <U+E300>710 for any
destination in town. Where are you headed?

Sorry, but you can’t ride our taxi service if you
don’t have the money.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
We used to have issues with battles breaking out
if the rider didn’t have the fare...

Thanks for choosing Lumi Cab! Just <U+E300>710 for any
destination in town. Where are you headed?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Oh... I’m really sorry, but we can’t give you a ride
unless you have the money.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Company policy, you see. To avoid trouble with
the customers.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Just as Z is the ultimate letter,
I am the ultimate taxi driver! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Need to get somewhere?
Lumi Cab is here for you! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Why not save yourself some
travel time? Try Lumi Cab! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Well, you’re in luck, friend. I’ve had zero accidents
or violations in my entire time as a cabbie!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
’Course that doesn’t mean I’ll always be accident-
free, but I’m gonna drive extra safe.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Can’t go getting injured if I want to keep battling
in the Z-A Royale!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Did I ever tell you how I manage to stay accident-
free, friend?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s kinda hard to explain, to be honest... When
I’m driving, it’s like I can see myself from above,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
you know? I’m able to look down at my own cab<U+0010><U+0001>븀
and everything going on around it.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
So I can stay safe around other vehicles, and I can
even tell when a Pokémon’s gonna leap out.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
That’s why I’m such a safe driver.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, did I ever tell you I used to be a racer?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s true! I used to participate in those 24-hour
races. You know what those are?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
We’d drive around the same track over and over
to check a car’s stability, stuff like that.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It was fun, actually—making sure the vehicle was
safe in extreme situations, all while trying to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
shave an extra 0.1 seconds off our time.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Still, I figured it would be more fun driving
customers to wherever they wanted to go, so I<U+0010><U+0001>븀
switched jobs and became a cabbie.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, friend, did I ever tell you what the most
important thing is for us cabbies?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Don’t get me wrong, a lot of things are important,
but I’d say keeping track of Lumiose traffic is the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
highest priority for us.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Me? I’ve got it all memorized—which roads get
crowded at what times, the whole deal. And all<U+0010><U+0001>븀
that changes if it rains, for example—right?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I mean, of course it does. Some Pokémon like the
rain and some don’t, after all.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Y’know, I had this cool encounter during my shift
once. Want to hear about it?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, this story is from back when people could
use the Gogoat Shuttle to get around Lumiose.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
’Course, that service had to be discontinued, what
with all the new Pokémon living in town.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Anyway, I had a customer who said he was an
officer with the International Police!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And wouldn’t you know it, he gets in my cab and
says “follow that car!”<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I knew it was my moment to shine, you know? I
know Lumiose like the back of my hand, after all.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
What happened, you ask? Naturally we were able
to catch the fleeing criminal! I even got an award<U+0010><U+0001>븀
for my part in the whole thing!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, friend, do you know the airspeed velocity of
an unladen Skarmory?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Sorry, it’s a random question, isn’t it? But they do
go really fast—over 180 miles per hour, in fact.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
That’s too fast even for my cab to catch up with.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But see, I actually had to chase one down... Yes,
that’s right, I had a car chase with a Pokémon!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The Skarmory was trying to get away, but I used
my knowledge of Lumiose and my driving skills to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
bring it in.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I figured if it’s flying, I’d fly too! So I predicted the
route it’d take, launched my car off a ramp, and<U+0010><U+0001>븀
snagged myself a nice catch.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

By the way, do you know who keeps our cabs in
tip-top shape?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The company mechanics, of course! Well, most of
the time. See, I operate as an independent cabbie,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
so I have to maintain my car myself.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’m more than just an excellent driver—I may not
look it, but I’m also a pretty decent mechanic!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
My car’s never had any kind of mechanical failure.
I get a lot of respect from my mechanic buddies, I<U+0010><U+0001>븀
tell you what!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Hope you don’t mind listening to me ramble a bit,
friend, but did I tell you the first time I ever drove<U+0010><U+0001>븀
a car was when I was three years old?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, Rhyhorn racing’s really popular in Kalos,
right? My old man’s a huge fan too. He wanted<U+0010><U+0001>븀
me to become a Rhyhorn racer!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
So he let me drive around in one of those go-karts
to get me used to the speed.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And that’s what set me up for life! I was able to
drift and everything, without anyone teaching me.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You could say I’m a natural behind the wheel, but
being a cabbie is only my second favorite thing in<U+0010><U+0001>븀
life right now.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, friend, do you know the Pokémon Trainer
Leon?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
He’s quite the customer, let me tell you. Everyone
knows how easily he gets lost, but I didn’t expect<U+0010><U+0001>븀
it to happen while he was in my cab!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
See, I think of myself as one of the better cabbies
in Lumiose, and I know this city inside and out.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But somehow, when Leon was my fare, things
kept happening that’d take us farther and farther<U+0010><U+0001>븀
away from where we wanted to go!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I did finally manage to get Leon to his destination,
but man, what a weird experience...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Have you ever seen a cab haul a Pokémon?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Oh—of course, if they’re in their Poké Balls, then
a cab could carry any number of them. I’m talking<U+0010><U+0001>븀
about a wild Pangoro.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I came across one that was badly injured—it
must’ve had a fight with another Pokémon.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I couldn’t just leave it there, so I got it on the roof
of my cab to take it to a Pokémon Center.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But the light on the car roof must’ve rubbed it in a
painful way, because the Pangoro started<U+0010><U+0001>븀
thrashing around.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I used my driving skills to get it to a Pokémon
Center as fast as I could, driving at the exact<U+0010><U+0001>븀
speed limit the whole time!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
That was some mighty fine driving, if I do say so
myself.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
All these wild Pokémon in the city, though... They
definitely changed how we do things here.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

By the by, friend—something tells me you’re one
of the Trainers in the Z-A Royale.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s so much fun, isn’t it? I’m taking part myself,
but I can’t win a promotion match for the life of<U+0010><U+0001>븀
me. Now everyone calls me Le Z Éternel.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Still, it’s such an intense experience. I wouldn’t
miss it for the world.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Are you a Pokémon Trainer, friend? I happen to be
a Trainer too, but I can’t say I’m very good.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
When I’m driving I see everything—other cars, my
surroundings—as if I’m watching from above.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But in a Pokémon battle, all I can think about is
how to defeat the Pokémon right in front of me.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
What do you think I should do?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Are you a Pokémon Trainer, friend? I happen to be
a Trainer too.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I managed to memorize all the type matchups, but
that’s some complicated stuff! Goes right out of<U+0010><U+0001>븀
my head the minute a battle begins.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Are you taking part in the Z-A Royale? How’re the
promotion matches treating you?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Me, I can’t seem to win at all. I’ve been stuck at
Rank Z for so long, people call me Le Z Éternel.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
See, I don’t mind people poking a bit of fun at me,
but I do take issue when they make fun of my<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Pokémon. My critters always try their very best!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Are you taking part in the Z-A Royale? I’ve been
neck-deep in it myself.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
My work used to be what kept me going, but now
all I can think about is the Z-A Royale.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
It’s almost like I’ve betrayed a loved one, actually.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s been forever since I even took my cab for a
wash... I hope it’s not mad at me.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, friend, do you know about the detective
named Emma?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
She’s young but a brilliant sleuth nonetheless.
Though she tends to rely on her physical prowess<U+0010><U+0001>븀
and Trainer skills over deductive reasoning to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
solve cases.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Her showdown with the art thieves who tried to
rob the Lumiose Museum is still a hot topic!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
See, there was this group of thieves who used
Pokémon to sneak into the museum and rob the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
place. But when they tried to make their escape,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Emma was right there waiting for them.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s as if she had used Future Sight or something!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
In the end, the thieves all got caught, and since
then, nobody’s tried to rob the museum—though<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Pokémon do still sneak in from time to time.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Were you around when we had that big parade,
friend?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Back then, a lot was going on in Lumiose—in the
whole Kalos region, actually.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
There was this group called Team Flare, and they
activated something called the ultimate weapon...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Some actually thought it was the end of the
world. So then a Pokémon Professor planned a<U+0010><U+0001>븀
big parade to cheer everyone up, but...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, it didn’t really work. Folks were still scared,
and they started leaving Lumiose.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Part of the reason we have a redevelopment plan
is to stop the exodus of people. That plan was the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
start of some big changes for this city.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, have you heard about the ghost here in
Lumiose?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The story goes that there’s an elevator in a certain
building... Ride it up to the second floor, and as<U+0010><U+0001>븀
you get off, a girl suddenly appears behind you<U+0010><U+0001>븀
and says, “No, you’re not the one...”<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Then she vanishes!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Used to be that I’d hear that story all the time, but
me and my cabbie buddies were saying that we<U+0010><U+0001>븀
haven’t heard about it since all the Pokémon<U+0010><U+0001>븀
started living here.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Then again, I’ve heard another story these days...
One about a girl who’s somehow riding your cab<U+0010><U+0001>븀
without you ever having let her on.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I hear all she says is, “You’re not the one, either...”<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Have you heard the story about the first ever
Mega Evolution here in Kalos?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
As it goes, a long, long time ago, a Trainer with a
Lucario came to visit the Tower of Mastery.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
While they were in the area, they found two
strange stones.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
As it turns out, one was a Key Stone, same as the
one on a Mega Ring.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The other was a Mega Stone, just like the one
you’d give to your Pokémon!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

You know, friend, I ran into a traveling minstrel
once, and they told me quite the tale.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“The Kalos region, now upheld as fair,
From ancient days an ugly past doth bear.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The woes of war did knock on every door,
Till man nor Pokémon could take no more,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Three thousand years ago, upon this shore.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
So many lives were lost—both man and ’mon.
It seemed a night that ne’er would bring dawn.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
No beauty, no joy in those days of yore;
Only the pain of parting was in store<U+0010><U+0001>븀
For victims of the ancient Kalos war.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Man’s grief brought the end, the land did tear,
Wartime finished in a lightning flare.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
’Mon’s rage brought the end, a furious roar,
Lightning crackled forth to end the war—<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Kalos’s long pain was then no more.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
One man, through it all, lives ever on.
To a Pokémon once lost, he’s ever drawn.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
One man, through it all, lives ever on.
Searching for his heart, long lost and gone.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
At last his labors brought end to his chore.
Bountiful kindness from his heart did pour,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
His Pokémon to part with nevermore.”<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Can you imagine wandering the world for three
thousand years? Don’t think I could ever do it...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Well, maybe if I had my cab, I could.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Hey, now... I didn’t expect someone earning in the
Z-A Royale to come up short on cash.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/
Hope to see you again soon!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Say, boss, did you know that Prism Tower’s been
remodeled and renovated a few times?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I hear its...skeleton? Its framework? The insides,
whatever you call them, are pretty old.

Did you know that the Gare de Lumiose was built
four years ago as part of the railway connecting<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Lumiose to the airport?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Funny thing is, only Pokémon showed up to the
grand opening ceremony! I’m glad they like the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
train, but Pokémon aren’t paying customers...

Did you know that each Pokémon move has its
own area of effect, boss?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Apparently, moves with large areas of effect can
hit multiple opponents at once!

You know how Mega Power gets charged up each
time a Pokémon uses a move, right, boss?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, here’s the thing... Word on the street is that
Pokémon don’t get as much Mega Power if their<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Trainer is far away!

Hey, boss, have you run into a driver named
Zach yet?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
He’s a buddy of mine who also works as a cabbie,
but nowadays all he talks about is the Z-A Royale.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Barely does any driving, you know?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
In fact, folks have started saying it’s good luck to
catch a ride in his cab, given how rare that is.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
What’s more, I hear he’s not doing too great in
the Z-A Royale, either. Guess liking something<U+0010><U+0001>븀
doesn’t make you good at it, eh?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Maybe you’ll bump into him next time you’re
battling in the Z-A Royale.

By the way, boss, you know any good restaurants
here in Lumiose?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I know, I know, you’d think a taxi driver would
know all about that sort of thing.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But the problem is I can just go anywhere since
I have a car, so I always end up going to little<U+0010><U+0001>븀
out-of-the-way places.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
My customers ask me all the time about popular
places to eat around here, but really, I’m the one<U+0010><U+0001>븀
who wants to know!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Speaking of—you wanna know something we
cabbies look for when choosing a place to eat?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
A parking spot where wild Pokémon won’t
destroy our cars, that’s what!

Hey, uh, boss, do you...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
No, never mind. I’m sure it’s nothing.

Did I mention I love to make curry, boss? It’s a
hobby of mine, actually. I even get all my spices<U+0010><U+0001>븀
shipped in from the Galar region.

You ever seen a Shiny Pokémon, boss? I actually
saw one while I was driving a customer around.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But the guy was in a hurry—I couldn’t just pull
over to catch a Pokémon. Don’t you hate it when<U+0010><U+0001>븀
that kind of thing happens?

Oh, we’re almost there! Time flies when you’re
chatting, am I right?

Okie dokie, here we are, boss! Safe and sound
<U+0010><U+0002>Ǔ<U+0002>!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
That’ll be, uhhh...<U+E300>710.

Hey, what’s the deal?! You don’t have enough
money!
Make sure you fasten your seat belt.

By the way, do you like Sushi High Roller?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I eat there from time to time, but I can never resist
ordering one of their full courses. The Pokémon<U+0010><U+0001>븀
battles take up my whole break!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I hear Sushi High Roller has branches in other
regions too, actually.

Did you know the Gare de Lumiose was used to
film a movie? It starred a big-name actor too.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
People came from all over the place to catch a
glimpse of her. It was pretty wild around here!

Did you know that each Pokémon move has a
specific range?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
That means it’s possible for a move to fall short
of the opponent if they’re far enough away!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I guess the important thing when choosing a
move is to make sure your opponent is in range.

You know how it takes Pokémon a little time
before they can use the same move again?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, I’ve heard people say that if a Pokémon has
a high Speed stat, that time gets reduced a bit!

You probably know that there are lots of ways for
Pokémon to evolve, but did you know that some<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Pokémon won’t evolve unless you’re really<U+0010><U+0001>븀
friendly with them?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
If you wanna get closer to your Pokémon, the best
thing to do is spend time with them at a café!

Hey, have you heard about the cup of coffee that
goes for <U+E300>100,000?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’ve never had it myself, obviously, but I have to
wonder how it tastes...

Have you been using your Boxes to store your
Pokémon? One Box can hold up to 30 of them!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You’ll only have access to eight Boxes at first, but
don’t worry—the more Pokémon you deposit, the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
more Boxes you’ll have.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
By the way, you can also swap the positions of
entire Boxes at once!

Say, did I mention I’m really good at making
sandwiches? I get all my ingredients from the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Paldea region, even!

This is a bit out of nowhere, but you know how
some people get nervous with too much quiet?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, I had a customer like that, so I suggested a
Pokémon naming game.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“Let’s name every Pokémon we can think of that
doesn’t evolve!” I said.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, guess which Pokémon they named first?
Eevee.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
...Yeah, the ride got really awkward really quickly.

So, you’re riding by yourself today, is that right?
...No, no, it’s nothing.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Uh, actually, sorry to keep asking about this, but
you DID get in the taxi alone, right?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Oh...don’t mind me. I’m probably just seeing
things...
Ah, here’s your destination coming up.

I hope you enjoyed your ride! We’ve now arrived
<U+0010><U+0002>Ǔ<U+0002>!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
That’ll be <U+E300>710, thanks.

Hey, wait a sec! You don’t have enough for the full
fare! Goodness me...
